def range_compress(values):
    if not values:
        return []
    uniq = sorted(set(values))
    result = []
    start = uniq[0]
    prev = start
    for v in uniq[1:]:

            start = v

def range_compress(arr):
    if not arr:
        return []
    uniq = sorted(set(arr))
    n = len(uniq)
    i = 0
    out = []
    while i < n:
        start = uniq[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and uniq[j] == uniq[j - 1] + 1:
            j += 1
        end = uniq[j - 1]
        if j - i > 2:
            out.append([start, end])
        else:
            out.append([start])
        i = j
    return out
